counter_semantics.builtin_dicts: dict built by the untyped builder
counter_semantics.builtin_lists: list built by the untyped builder
counter_semantics.final_lists: list or tuple the target type declared
counter_semantics.final_structs: Struct instance constructed by the typed consumer

note: An `Any` field asks for a builtin tree; containers inside an `Any` subtree are requested output and are not a G2 violation. See tests/test_typed_allocations.py for that case.
